speaker: Chand Sadagar
text: I worship Mahadev. Why should I bow to a serpent goddess? Let Mansa do her worst!

speaker: Mata Mansa Devi
text: Pride blinds you, Chand. Your ships will sink. Your sons will fall.

speaker: Narrator
text: Iron could guard the chamber. It could not guard against fate.

speaker: Behula
text: I will not surrender him to death. Build me a raft. I will seek the heavens.

speaker: Narrator
text: With love as her offering, she crossed the river between the living and the divine.

speaker: Mata Mansa Devi
text: Your devotion has moved the heavens. His life and the ships may be restored—but Chand must acknowledge me.

speaker: Chand Sadagar
text: My right hand belongs to Shiva. With my left, I offer you this flower, Mother.

speaker: Narrator
text: Did pride bow at last—or did it simply find another way to stand?
